principles: Acquisition Technique is not Execution Environment.
Product Identity is not Variant Identity.
Blocked access is not extraction failure.

values.label: Official public surface
values.definition: An official customer-facing source reachable without supplied credentials.

values.label: Structured catalog
values.definition: A first-party structured representation of a catalog.

values.label: Static discovery surface
values.definition: Robots, sitemap, or other static public discovery material.

values.label: Rendered commerce surface
values.definition: A rendered page exposing attributable commerce observations.

values.label: Single-page application
values.definition: A client-rendered application whose discovery and extraction paths may differ.

values.label: Public marketplace surface
values.definition: A contextual marketplace page whose displays are observations rather than national truth.

values.label: Official metadata service
values.definition: A documented official metadata interface with explicit policy and quota boundaries.

values.label: Official API
values.definition: Read an official documented or validated public structured interface.

values.label: Sitemap to canonical detail
values.definition: Discover canonical detail URLs through sitemap evidence and extract the detail surface.

values.label: Canonical detail catalog
values.definition: Extract attributable product identity and fields from bounded official canonical detail pages.

values.label: SSR catalog
values.definition: Materialize product observations from server-rendered or embedded catalog state.

values.label: Rendered DOM
values.definition: Extract bounded attributable observations from rendered page content.

values.label: Browser observation
values.definition: Use one reviewed browser page-load or capture without access-control circumvention.

values.label: Application-bundle discovery
values.definition: Mine public application bundles for discovery clues without treating names as validated data.

values.label: First-party network discovery
values.definition: Use bounded first-party network evidence to discover a catalog frontier.

values.label: Uploads playlist monitoring
values.definition: Use an official channel uploads playlist for reviewed dry monitoring plans.

values.label: Official menu detail
values.definition: Extract explicitly price-labelled items from official public menu detail pages.

values.label: Cloud runner
values.definition: Default cloud-hosted execution environment.

values.label: Thailand Edge runner
values.definition: Separately approved normal-network Thailand execution environment.

values.label: Normal unauthenticated browser
values.definition: Fresh normal browser context with no supplied session material.

values.label: Static public HTTP
values.definition: Ordinary unauthenticated HTTP execution.

values.label: Environment not evidenced
values.definition: Repository evidence does not establish an execution-environment requirement.

values.label: Structured response
values.definition: Sanitized structured fields from a validated official response.

values.label: Sitemap evidence
values.definition: Official robots or sitemap discovery evidence.

values.label: Canonical detail evidence
values.definition: Attributable official product-detail identity and fields.

values.label: Rendered card evidence
values.definition: Bounded rendered cards with attributable identity and semantics.

values.label: Sanitized browser capture
values.definition: A bounded capture excluding credentials, browser state, and raw private material.

values.label: Public app-bundle evidence
values.definition: Sanitized public bundle strings or operations used for discovery.

values.label: Workflow validation
values.definition: Durable evidence from a deterministic or reviewed lifecycle workflow.

values.label: Negative access evidence
values.definition: A sanitized challenge, shell, login, or environment-boundary observation.

values.label: Deterministic fixture
values.definition: Synthetic or sanitized fixture evidence used to verify semantic behavior.

values.label: Policy contract
values.definition: Repository policy defining permitted and prohibited behavior.

values.label: Sellable product and price
values.definition: Price is attributable to a sellable product identity.

values.label: Discovery frontier
values.definition: Evidence expands discovery but is not automatically the extraction source.

values.label: Displayed order only
values.definition: Position is contextual display order and not demand or national rank.

values.label: Unknown counter
values.definition: Raw numeric display is retained without asserting sold, orders, or reviews.

values.label: Explicit sold counter
values.definition: A source-labelled public sold display, not a transaction ledger.

values.label: Variant unresolved
values.definition: Product identity match does not establish equivalent selected variants.

values.label: Metadata not transcript
values.definition: Official video metadata does not imply transcript or audiovisual acquisition.

values.label: Price role preserved
values.definition: Current, from, promotional, discount, and unknown price roles remain distinct.

values.label: Usable evidence
values.definition: The bounded technique produced evidence valid for its stated scope.

values.label: Partial evidence
values.definition: Some scoped evidence is usable while important semantics or coverage remain unresolved.

values.label: Boundary reached
values.definition: Execution stopped safely at an authentication, challenge, or environment boundary.

values.label: Candidate only
values.definition: A deterministic contract or clue exists without a live validated outcome.

values.label: Application shell
values.definition: HTTP completed but no stable usable product signal was present.

values.label: Traffic verification
values.definition: A challenge/access-control page stopped the attempt.

values.label: Login required
values.definition: The public attempt reached a required authentication boundary.

values.label: Cloud access blocked
values.definition: The cloud environment was unsuitable while the technique was not itself disproven.

values.label: Insufficient evidence
values.definition: Evidence was too weak to assert the intended semantic or outcome.

values.label: Cross-domain generic
values.definition: The pattern can transfer across domains with source-specific field mapping.

values.label: Domain-level
values.definition: The pattern is reusable within a domain subject to validation.

values.label: Source-specific
values.definition: The technique or conclusion depends on one source's contract.

values.label: Reviewed durable evidence
values.definition: A durable reviewed validation or registry artifact.

values.label: Deterministic regression evidence
values.definition: A repeatable fixture or contract enforced by tests.

values.label: Contract only
values.definition: A documented candidate without completed source validation.

values.label: Repository reviewed
values.definition: Accepted durable repository evidence without claiming human Ground Truth.

values.label: Deterministic validation
values.definition: Authority is limited to repeatable deterministic behavior.

values.label: Explicit human confirmation
values.definition: A human-confirmed label with explicit reviewer provenance.

values.label: Technique-profile fingerprint
values.definition: Material technique configuration changes invalidate stale approval evidence.

values.label: Refresh required
values.definition: Time-sensitive source evidence requires bounded revalidation before reuse.

values.label: Drift not evidenced
values.definition: No reviewed change/drift conclusion is available.

values.label: Strong scoped quality
values.definition: Scoped validation passed its documented quality and provenance gates.

values.label: Partial scoped quality
values.definition: Evidence is usable but incomplete for one or more intended semantics.

values.label: Zero usable evidence
values.definition: The bounded attempt produced no usable normalized evidence and remains valuable negative learning.

values.label: Quality not measured
values.definition: No reviewed source-quality or yield measurement is claimed.

values.label: Quota evidenced
values.definition: A documented API quota or bounded request budget is explicitly preserved.

values.label: Cost and latency not evidenced
values.definition: No exact cost or latency is asserted.

values.label: Public no-auth
values.definition: Only official public surfaces without supplied authentication are used.

values.label: Stop on access control
values.definition: Authentication, CAPTCHA, challenge, and access-control boundaries must not be bypassed.

values.label: Production disabled
values.definition: Evidence does not authorize production storage, scheduling, or approval.

values.label: Durable validation artifact
values.definition: Repository-retained validation evidence with explicit scope.

values.label: Configuration registry
values.definition: Versioned machine-readable source or technique registry evidence.

values.label: Deterministic fixture
values.definition: Sanitized fixture and test evidence.

values.label: Documentation contract
values.definition: Reviewed repository documentation defining semantics and boundaries.
